facts.en: Completed an office systems diploma at Fictional Bramble Moon College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构荆月学院完成办公系统文凭课程。

facts.en: Completed an introductory project scheduling course in 2024-05, without a professional project-management credential.
facts.zh: 2024-05 完成项目排期入门课程，未获专业项目管理资格。

facts.en: Office assistant at Fictional Copper Kite, 2020-09 to 2022-12.
facts.zh: 2020-09 至 2022-12 在虚构铜鸢机构任办公室助理。

facts.en: Project team assistant at Fictional Copper Kite, 2023-01 to 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2025-03 在虚构铜鸢机构任项目团队助理。

facts.en: Project administration coordinator at Fictional Copper Kite, 2025-04 to 2026-09; this was a promotion, not a new employer.
facts.zh: 2025-04 至 2026-09 在虚构铜鸢机构任项目行政协调员；此为晋升，并非更换雇主。

facts.en: As office assistant, arranged stationery deliveries and meeting rooms, not project budgets.
facts.zh: 任办公室助理时安排文具配送及会议室，不负责项目预算。

facts.en: Maintains action logs, meeting notes, and owner-approved milestone dates for the project team.
facts.zh: 为项目团队维护行动日志、会议笔记及责任人批准的里程碑日期。

facts.en: Coordinates 3 active internal projects in 2026-09; the 2025-10 peak administrative workload covered 5 projects.
facts.zh: 2026-09 协调 3 个活跃内部项目；2025-10 行政工作高峰覆盖 5 个项目。

facts.en: Supported a workspace move during 2025-06 to 2025-08 with a project manager and facilities lead.
facts.zh: 2025-06 至 2025-08 与项目经理及设施负责人共同支持办公区搬迁。

facts.en: Personally consolidated 21 action items and sent owner-approved reminders; the manager decided priorities.
facts.zh: 个人汇总 21 个行动项并发送责任人批准的提醒；优先级由经理决定。

facts.en: The team recorded 18 of 21 actions closed by the 2025-08 review date; no budget saving or causal productivity gain was measured.
facts.zh: 团队记录，截至 2025-08 审核日期，21 个行动项中有 18 个关闭；未测量预算节省或因果生产率提升。

facts.en: Published the approved move-day checklist to the internal team folder before the move.
facts.zh: 搬迁前将获批搬迁日核对表发布至内部团队文件夹。

facts.en: Drafted a dependency-risk diagram in 2026-02; the project manager had not adopted it by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草依赖风险图；截至 2026-09 项目经理尚未采用。

facts.en: Uses shared calendars, spreadsheet status filters, and document version history.
facts.zh: 使用共享日历、电子表格状态筛选及文档版本历史。

facts.en: Escalates overdue decisions to project owners without changing approved scope.
facts.zh: 将逾期决策上报项目责任人，不更改批准范围。

facts.en: A course exercise planned an imaginary 4-week exhibition; it did not represent a delivered client project.
facts.zh: 一项课程练习规划了假想的 4 周展览；并非已交付的客户项目。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Night Garden on 2025-09 weekends alongside full-time paid work.
facts.zh: 2025-09 周末为虚构夜花园活动做志愿者，与全职有薪工作同期。

facts.en: At the garden event, prepared sign-in sheets from organizer instructions; did not manage the event.
facts.zh: 在花园活动中依据组织方指示准备签到表；未管理活动。

facts.en: Made a personal archive of 23 fictional postcard designs in 2023-07.
facts.zh: 2023-07 为 23 张虚构明信片设计制作个人档案。

facts.en: Enjoys birdwatching and miniature painting.
facts.zh: 爱好观鸟及微缩模型绘画。

facts.en: An unsigned role summary says project manager; the employment record and approval log describe administrative coordination.
facts.zh: 一份未署名岗位总结称项目经理；任职记录及审批日志描述行政协调。

facts.en: No contract negotiation, budget approval, or independent project scope ownership is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录合同谈判、预算审批或独立项目范围责任。
